rawContent: I was so glad to contribute a chapter to this wonderful @Harvard_Press book on US-China relations. I wrote about feminism and the #MeToo movement in China. Pre-order now!

So excited to have a chapter in this timely, wonderful volume, The China Questions 2: Critical Insights into US-China Relations, edited by @adele_carrai Jennifer Rudolph & @MichaelSzonyi. I wrote about feminism and #MeToo in China. Out August 30th! https://t.co/TWMqwfhL1P https://t.co/EACqk1xEpI
